user.title: Set up SunMon
user.description: Reads the power and voltage of a SolarCount over RS485 (57600 baud, 8N1).

data_description.serial_port: The USB to RS485 adapter. Prefer the /dev/serial/by-id/... path, it stays the same after replugging.
data_description.channels: How many SolarCount channels to read, starting with the first.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the SolarCount is read.
data_description.trace_serial: Writes every byte sent and received to the Home Assistant log at level TRACE. Switch it off again after troubleshooting, it fills the log quickly.

no_response.title: The SolarCount does not answer
no_response.description:
The serial port {port} opened, but the SolarCount did not answer. Check the wiring (A/B swapped?) and that it is powered.

If you set it up anyway, Home Assistant keeps trying to reach it in the background, and the sensors appear once it answers.

error.cannot_connect: The serial port could not be opened. Check the path and that no other program uses it.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.
